chip.description: Sprite generator paired with the 053246 on Konami System GX and the Mystic Warriors family; the higher-colour-depth alternative to the 053247.
chip.notes: src/mame/konami/k053246_k053247_k055673.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("053246 with 053247 or 055673"; the source asks whether "the 053247 / 055673 choice [is] just a BPP change like the tilemaps"). konamiic.txt lists 055673 in the sprites column with 053246 for Gaiapolis, Mystic Warriors, Violent Storm, Monster Maulers, Metamorphic Force, Run and Gun and System GX.
